principal_service_binding_prepare_reques.description: Request a service-generated frozen binding core. Omitting expected_current_binding_digest is a create-if-absent CAS; supplying it is a same-service replacement CAS. The service resolves the authenticated principal's current DID authority itself and never accepts caller-supplied service metadata, authority evidence, timestamps or binding fields.

principal_service_binding_prepare_outcom.description: Durable single-use challenge plus the exact binding core the principal authorizes. binding_draft.authorization_challenge equals challenge_id byte for byte and is covered by binding_digest. accepted_at and not_before equal issued_at byte for byte. expires_at bounds challenge use, not binding validity; optional binding_draft.expires_at is independently chosen by service policy. Exact request_id replay returns the same unconsumed outcome; same request_id with different intent is duplicate_conflict.

principal_service_binding_commit_request.description: Commit the exact frozen draft. The verifier loads challenge state, recomputes binding_digest and the principal proof transcript, resolves the proof method at binding_draft.accepted_at, and requires that method to be current principal authorization. The client never submits a service proof or reconstructed binding object.
